objective: Build a pristine Primary Archive from Estelita’s OBRAS and FONOGRAMAS spreadsheets to drive precise matching against revenue reports from broadcasters and streaming services, enabling accurate and auditable royalty reconciliation.

primary_sources.name: ESTELITA OBRAS (v1/v2)
primary_sources.description: Excel files containing music works/obras and contributor information. Key columns include Código/ISWC, Título da obra, Autor/Compositor, Intérprete, Pseudônimo, CAE/IPI, Associação (society), flags like ORIGINAL, date fields INÍCIO/FIM, role codes, and share percentages.

primary_sources.name: ESTELITA FONOGRAMAS (v1/v2)
primary_sources.description: Excel files listing recordings/fonogramas with metadata. Columns typically include ISRC, Título do fonograma, Intérprete/Artista principal, Participações, Álbum, Gravadora/Label, Duração, Ano and ownership fields.

primary_sources.name: Revenue Reports
primary_sources.description: Reports from broadcasters and streaming providers (e.g., UBEM, SBT, Globo, Globoplay) containing channel, program, period, date/time of exhibition, song title, artist, duration and sometimes monetary values.

deliverables: Primary Archive workbook with WORKS, RECORDINGS, GAZETTEER, ALIASES and RELATIONS tables
Cleaned OBRAS spreadsheet (ESTELITA_OBRAS_CLEAN.xlsx) and its bold version
Schema statistics (Schema_Stats.xlsx) and run logs (Run_Log.txt, Run_Summary.json)
Matches reports (e.g., Matches_Globo.xlsx) for high-confidence work↔recording links
Review queue and unknown codes lists for ambiguous or unmatched items
processing_pipeline: Normalize text: apply Unicode NFKD, remove diacritics, convert to lowercase, collapse whitespace and punctuation.
Extract and split title qualifiers (e.g., AO VIVO, VERSÃO, ACÚSTICO, REMIX) into a separate array while retaining a base title for matching.
Validate codes: extract ISRC/ISWC/CAE/IPI; if malformed, store them in *_raw fields.
Convert dates from dd/mm/aaaa or Excel serials to ISO YYYY-MM-DD; preserve originals in *_raw fields.
Block-list certain tokens (e.g., publisher names, broadcasters) from being interpreted as artists or titles.
Build cleaned DataFrames per source and merge duplicates by preferring codes or fuzzy title+artist/duration matches.
Use `ingest_fornecedores.py` to detect schemas, parse cue sheets and synchronization reports, output cleaned files, unify results and log pending or unrecognized files.
Use `clean_estelita.py` to clean and structure OBRAS spreadsheets, extracting code, title, date, original flag and percentage fields.
Use `search_light` module or similar to perform fuzzy matching (≤10% edit distance) on titles and names when linking works to recordings and revenue rows.
Generate per-provider summaries, schema statistics and run logs to monitor coverage and highlight missing or unknown formats.

order: fuzzy review with ≤10% token edit distance
matching_strategy.confidence_score: For fuzzy links, compute confidence as 1 - normalized edit distance; require ≥0.9 and additional disambiguators for common titles (e.g., amor, love, intro).
matching_strategy.notes: Ambiguous matches or common titles are queued for manual review.

data_normalization.date_conversion: Excel serials and strings are converted to ISO format; invalid dates remain in *_raw fields.
data_normalization.shares_raw: Percentage/share columns are captured verbatim without interpretation.

scripts_and_tools.clean_estelita.py: Reads the OBRAS source file, extracts code, title, holder, date, 'ORIGINAL' flag and percentage columns, drops empty rows and outputs clean and bold Excel files.
scripts_and_tools.ingest_fornecedores.py: Recursively scans per-provider directories, detects schema (UBEM_CUESHEET vs UBEM_RELATORIO), parses relevant columns, writes per-provider cleaned files, builds a unified dataset and logs pending/unrecognized files.
scripts_and_tools.search_light.py: Provides fuzzy search and matching functions with up to 10% tolerance, supporting trigram filters and edit distance per token.
scripts_and_tools.match_globo.py (planned): Matches records from Globo_clean.xlsx against the Primary Archive recordings table, using fuzzy title/artist matching and capturing monetary values when available.

directory_structure.raw_inputs: Estelita/Raw/Fornecedores/<provider>/... contains original revenue reports and cue sheets grouped by provider
directory_structure.logs: SHRKVSCODE/Processed/Logs/ holds Pending_Files.csv, Schema_Stats.xlsx, Run_Log.txt, Run_Summary.json
directory_structure.primary_archive: SHRKVSCODE/primary_archive.xlsx holds WORKS, RECORDINGS, GAZETTEER, ALIASES, RELATIONS tables

future_work: Extend schema detection to handle new formats (e.g., TV aberta cue sheets, association reports).
Capture monetary values and durations from revenue reports; store in unified dataset for royalties calculation.
Normalize names and titles across multiple languages and transliterations.
Implement automated deduplication and merging logic for works lacking ISWC/ISRC codes.
Develop a robust matching pipeline that produces matches with confidence scores and reasons.
Provide dashboards summarizing ingestion coverage, pending files and matching success rate per provider.
